session_note: The 94th Minnesota Legislature covers the 2025-2026 biennium; the 2026 regular session adjourned Sine Die on 2026-05-18 (constitutional deadline, first Monday after the third Saturday in May), which is the end of the biennium -- there is no further carryover beyond this date. A bill with no committee vote or floor action recorded by 2026-05-18 is dead. All action-history data below comes from each bill's own page on revisor.mn.gov (the Legislature's official bill-tracking system), read via its status log rather than any auto-generated summary label.
